reasons: Non-minimal edit: p0103 was rewritten wholesale (changed-character ratio 1.084), failing the deterministic minimal-edit check and the rule's redline guidance to 'replace only the jurisdiction words and forum; keep the rest of the sentence intact.'

The redline injects new language not present in the original ('without regard to its conflict-of-laws rules'), which is outside the scope of the GOVLAW fix and expands the negotiation surface unnecessarily.

The forum clause was deleted rather than re-pointed; a minimal, self-consistent edit would substitute the jurisdiction words in place, e.g. '28.1 This Agreement is governed exclusively by the laws of the State of New York, and the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York have exclusive jurisdiction.'

Substance and direction are correct (New York is the preferred position, conflict with 28.2 is properly identified, and the comment cites the fallback), so re-issuing the same finding with a surgical word-level substitution should pass.
